skills.description: Publish to Medium without an API token. Medium closed its API to new integrations in Jan 2025, so this skill uses the one stable path left: it writes your post as Medium-ready HTML, deploys it to your own GitHub Pages, and uses Medium's URL importer to create a draft. Say 'blog about X' and it scaffolds your blog repo on first run, then drafts each post end to end. It always stops at a draft for your review and never auto-publishes. Needs GitHub, Medium, and the gh CLI.
skills.description_zh: 无需API令牌即可发布到Medium。由于Medium在2025年1月关闭了新集成的API，该技能使用唯一稳定方案：将文章写成Medium可用HTML，部署到你的GitHub Pages，再通过Medium的URL导入器创建草稿。说「写一篇关于X的博客」，首次运行时会搭建博客仓库，然后端到端起草每篇文章。始终停留在草稿阶段供你审核，不会自动发布。需要GitHub、Medium账户和gh CLI。
skills.name: Medium Blog Post Creator
